about: Settings MaliBridge applies to a Steam game by itself (KnownGames.kt). Keyed by Steam app id; each entry may carry a 'when' (gpu: deviceName substrings, any of them; driverMin/driverMax: Mali driver release like r32p1, inclusive; vulkanBelow/vulkanAtLeast: the Vulkan games see; bridge: only in Mali bridge sessions). Fields: tool (proton-experimental-arm64, proton-11-arm64), dxvk (a version on the Nightlies, e.g. 1.10.3), fexPreset (a FEX preset id), env (KEY: VALUE for the game), bridge (VKBRIDGE_ KEY: VALUE, written to <bridge cache dir>/presets/<appid>.env). Only entries with evidence; 'source' says what it is based on. Titles with no entry follow the default tool.

322330.name: Don't Starve Together
322330.source: Tested on a Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra (Mali-G925): the default path closes a few seconds after start; WineD3D plays at 60 fps.

220.name: Half-Life 2
220.source: Player report, OnePlus phone (Mali-G710, Vulkan 1.1): starts with DXVK 1.10.3; Proton's own DXVK needs Vulkan 1.3.

294100.name: RimWorld
294100.source: Player report, OnePlus Ace 2V (Mali-G710, Vulkan 1.1): plays with DXVK 1.10.3; Proton's own DXVK needs Vulkan 1.3.

207350.name: Ys Origin
207350.source: Tested on a Retroid Pocket 4 Pro (Mali-G77, r32p1): Microsoft's own d3dx9_43 under FEX gives the particle and effect draws NaN world matrices (the 'white rooms'; on other GPUs the same draws are silently dropped). With Wine's builtin d3dx9_43 the room draws right without the bridge's nan_position guard, and the brazier fire and statue glow appear.

207320.name: Ys: The Oath in Felghana
207320.source: Tested on a Retroid Pocket 4 Pro (Mali-G77, r32p1): the DirectX 9 version draws only the HUD after a save loads; an apitrace shows every world matrix (c24-c31) as NaN from Microsoft's own d3dx9 under FEX. Wine's builtin d3dx9_41/43 draws the world at 69 fps.

560430.name: Indiana Jones and the Emperor's Tomb
560430.source: Player report, POCO X8 Pro (Mali-G720 MC8): the faster CPU presets stop it at start; Stability runs about 30 fps.
